find:
except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - re-raised as the honest failure
                raise ExportUnavailable(
                    f"Could not read table {table!r} from this site's database."
                ) from exc

label: the export stops paging after the first round trip, so a site with more than 500 rows is silently truncated and the owner keeps a partial copy of their own bookings
the table-name gate stops rejecting, so the one token interpolated into the export's SQL is no longer constrained to a plain identifier
the identifier pattern loosens to allow anything non-empty, which readmits quotes and semicolons into the FROM clause
the leads query drops its site_id filter, so a site's data export hands its owner every other site's form submissions in the same workspace
the bundle stops declaring what it omits, so an owner opening the file months later cannot tell that analytics and internal tables were never in it
